morphology.source: Vertically symmetrical white shield/helmet-like silhouette with a broad notched crown, sloped shoulders, paired inward diagonal seams, a narrow central stem, and a pointed V lower tip; pale blue edging/glow is contextual styling.
morphology.visibleDiscriminatingFeature: The source and secure crop share the same notched crown, outer shoulder angles, Y-like internal split, narrow center stem, and pointed lower V in the same proportions.

candidateVerdicts.visibleFeature: Outer contour and both internal seam paths align point-for-point; only source rendering adds blue glow and badge texture.
Autodestruction has three detached lobes around a central ring, absent from the source.
Malfunction is a broken gear/cog surrounding a circular opening, absent from the source.
Computer is a rectangular screen/terminal silhouette with no crown or V-point.
Robot is a broad head outline with two circular eye holes and a top tab, absent from the source.

conclusion: The central source glyph is an explicit visual match for the authoritative secure glossary icon; record secure only for the glyph, without promoting or creating a sidecar for the surrounding non-card texture.
promotionEffect: Icon identity may be recorded as secure. The asset itself remains a non-card DiffuseURL texture and is not a canonical sidecar promotion.
